profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Clearent by Xplor
profile.summary: Proud graduate of College of DuPage and Illinois Tech (BS, MS). Full stack experience, including OOP languages such as Java and C#. Experience working in micro-system architectures. Experience in parallel programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Backend/frontend development in a micro-services architecture.

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description: Development and design of .NET Core applications and services. Design and implementation of databases. Backend software development.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Python development for various APIs. AWS architecture design, configuration, and maintenance. Backend software development. Database management.
positions.insights: Python (Programming Language) and Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Web development using LAMP and Flask. Database design. Implemented REST APIs and a PHP backend.

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Run lab sessions, hold office hours, explain Data Structures concepts, and make computer science a little less scary.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
Development and execution of custom benchmark (Sonar) for I/O systems (currently LABIOS).

Sonar: https://github.com/ilopez5/sonar
LABIOS: https://dl.acm.org/doi/abs/10.1145/3307681.3325405
